name: Fire Fish
body:
Fire Fish
CR 1

XP 400
N Small animal (aquatic*, fire)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision, tremorsense 10 ft.; Perception +7; Aura heat (5 ft. radius)

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+1 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (3d8)
Fort +3; Ref +5; Will +2
Immune fire
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed swim 40 ft.
Melee slam –1 (1d4–4 plus heat)
Special Attacks heat (1d4 fire damage)

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 5
Base Atk +2; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative
Skills Perception +7, Sense Motive +3, Swim +15; Racial Modifiers modifies Swim with Dex

ECOLOGY

Environment Plane of Fire
Organization solitary or school (4–80)
Treasure none

Aquatic firefish can swim and breathe in molten lava as easily as a regular fish in water. They are ‘aquatic’ only in the sense that their natural environment is lava instead of water.
